label: Distributed ACID Transaction (Java SDK)
type: a multi-document, multi-operation unit of work executed via a retryable lambda passed to Cluster.transactions().run() - automatically committed on success or rolled back and retried on failure
note: Structurally distinct from sdk:kv-operations and sdk:sqlpp-queries-with-sdk (both single-call, single-outcome operations, promoted in round 30): this is a whole block of application logic that may re-execute. sdk:single-query-transaction is a lighter-weight, structurally restricted variant of this concept, not simply an instance of it - now folded (round 30) into concepts/n1ql/tximplicit.json as an alias, since it is the query-language mechanism's SDK-side surface, not an SDK-specific concept.
